evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rest.cpp handling of `/rest/getutxos` POST endpoints.
rationale: Fixes a data-correctness bug where binary and hex POST requests to `/rest/getutxos` falsely report valid outpoints as nonexistent. Serializing the body using `operator<<` prepended a `CompactSize` length byte that misaligned all subsequent request field parsing, rendering POST decoding for those formats broken.
